Simulated bifurcating trajectory

Source: R/data_doc.R
splat.sim.Rd

A SingleCellExperiment with the counts of 100 genes in 200 cells, simulated with splatter (Zappia et al. 2017) along two paths that start from the same point.

data("splat.sim", package = "scMaSigPro")

Format

A SingleCellExperiment with 100 genes (rows) and 200 cells (columns):

counts assay

The simulated counts.

colData

Cell, the cell name; Batch, the batch (one, "Batch1"); Group, the path of the cell, a factor with the levels "Path1" and "Path2"; ExpLibSize, its expected library size; Step, how far along its path the cell is (1 to 100), used as the pseudotime; sizeFactor, the size factor of scuttle::logNormCounts().

rowData

Gene, the gene name; BaseGeneMean, the base mean of the gene; OutlierFactor, its outlier factor; GeneMean, its mean after the outlier factor; LocalDEFacPath1 and LocalDEFacPath2, its differential expression factor along each path; DEFacPath1 and DEFacPath2, its factor at the end of each path; SigmaFacPath1 and SigmaFacPath2, the factor of its non-linear change along each path (0 for a linear change).

reducedDims

PCA, the first two principal components of the log-normalised counts.

Source

Simulated with splatter::splatSimulatePaths() (splatter 1.26.0, set.seed(123), 200 cells, 100 genes, two paths of 100 steps from the origin, de.prob = 0.3, de.facLoc = 0.2), normalised with scuttle::logNormCounts() and reduced with scater::runPCA(). The script is system.file("scripts", "make-splat-sim.R", package = "scMaSigPro").

References

Zappia L, Phipson B, Oshlack A (2017). Splatter: simulation of single-cell RNA sequencing data. Genome Biology 18, 174. doi:10.1186/s13059-017-1305-0

See also

Other datasets: multi.lin.sce, scmp.ob

Author

Priyansh Srivastava spriyansh29@gmail.com

Examples

data("splat.sim", package = "scMaSigPro")
table(SummarizedExperiment::colData(splat.sim)$Group)
#> 
#> Path1 Path2 
#>    97   103
